self_audit: Walked every FR-1..FR-18 and NFR-1..NFR-14 consequence in prd.md and the whole addendum (traceability matrix and counts) for: paging stop reasons, partial and mismatch states, absent fields (dispatchId, terminalState, owner, scope, page.total, N Runs), first-cycle and probe failure, staleness clocks and back-off, change detection over added/removed/unknown rows, counts with all-unknown members, width and height limits, NO_COLOR values, encoding, sanitizer coverage, signal handling, export and snapshot write/read races, snapshot versioning and coverage state, R2 retention across restart and closure. Spec companions were read only where the PRD names them as the single source (adapter-contract.md, rendering-rules.md, snapshot-export-schema.md) to drop gaps the source already handles (page.hasMore required, discovery probe outside the 5-call cap, invalid JSON and 8 MiB overflow as FAILED, missing-key sentinel). Open owner questions (OQ-1..15) were not counted as defects.

findings.trigger_condition: page.hasMore true but paging stops before the 5-call cap (cursor rejected, absent, oversize)
findings.guard_snippet: if page.hasMore and traversal_stopped and calls < CAP: state = 'PARTIAL (paging stopped: <reason>)'
findings.potential_consequence: Incomplete traversal renders as complete or mismatch, never PARTIAL

findings.trigger_condition: First cycle not finished yet, or first worker-list read fails; no last good snapshot
findings.guard_snippet: if last_good is None: ledger = 'worker-list not read yet' or 'FAILED (...) no prior read'; counts = unknown
findings.potential_consequence: Unread or failed fleet shows zero counts or an empty-fleet line

findings.trigger_condition: Worker row has no dispatchId, so identity becomes namespace plus UNKNOWN
findings.guard_snippet: if row.dispatchId is UNKNOWN: never dedupe; identity = ('no-id', cycle, page, index); flag 'identity unknown'
findings.potential_consequence: ID-less rows merge as duplicates and vanish; selection anchor breaks

findings.trigger_condition: terminalState absent, so historical-versus-active classification is unknown
findings.guard_snippet: if row.terminalState is UNKNOWN: always show; count as 'k historical-state unknown', never hidden
findings.potential_consequence: Unknown state silently treated as active, or hidden as historical

findings.trigger_condition: Row added after the mark, or removed from a page that was read
findings.guard_snippet: starred = added | removed_from_read_pages | watched_field_changed; 'not reobserved' only for rows on unread pages
findings.potential_consequence: New dispatches unstarred and uncounted; PRD contradicts spec's added/removed rule

findings.trigger_condition: Watched field flips known to unknown, or unknown to known, after the mark
findings.guard_snippet: changed = (old != new) or (old is UNKNOWN) != (new is UNKNOWN); UNKNOWN never compares equal to a value
findings.potential_consequence: A field vanishing from the source reads as unchanged

findings.trigger_condition: result.counts has many states or wide numbers at 80 columns
findings.guard_snippet: if cell_len(priority_tokens) > W: wrap priority tokens onto extra strip lines; never truncate, never exceed W
findings.potential_consequence: FR-10 never-truncate and NFR-1 cell_len <= W cannot both hold

findings.trigger_condition: Snapshot written for a PARTIAL, mismatch or changed-during-read cycle
findings.guard_snippet: snapshot.coverage = {state: PARTIAL|COMPLETE|MISMATCH|UNKNOWN, collected: n, reported: T or 'UNKNOWN', reason}
findings.potential_consequence: Consumer reads a partial snapshot with status OK as the whole fleet

findings.trigger_condition: Observer stops or hangs; snapshot file stops updating with status OK
findings.guard_snippet: consumer rule in FR-16: if now_utc - generatedAt > 45 s, treat source.status as STALE
findings.potential_consequence: A dead producer's last snapshot reads as fresh indefinitely

findings.trigger_condition: Consumer must tell historical from active rows; FR-16 says release state withheld
findings.guard_snippet: state in FR-16 whether row.terminalState is kept; if withheld, consumers must not count rows as active
findings.potential_consequence: PRD withholds release state; schema row carries terminalState; consumers may miscount

findings.trigger_condition: Observer restarts in R2; in-memory question retention is discarded
findings.guard_snippet: on start: 'retention reset at HH:MM; earlier open questions not carried'; add restart to SM-C4
findings.potential_consequence: Restart silently lowers the open count; seen-is-not-resolved broken

findings.trigger_condition: R2 ships while the closure-evidence feed is still a Later stage
findings.guard_snippet: FR-17: 'no item closes in R2; open total only rises until unknown (retention exceeded)'
findings.potential_consequence: Readers expect a closure path R2 does not have

findings.trigger_condition: Back-off raises interval to 60 s; spec defines STALE as 3 intervals
findings.guard_snippet: STALE_AFTER = 45.0 seconds monotonic, fixed; never 3 * current_interval
findings.potential_consequence: STALE delayed to 180 s during back-off under the spec's wording

findings.trigger_condition: Host suspends; Linux monotonic clock does not advance during sleep
findings.guard_snippet: age via time.clock_gettime(time.CLOCK_BOOTTIME), or STALE if wall gap exceeds monotonic gap
findings.potential_consequence: Hours-old data shows a young poll age after resume

findings.trigger_condition: Every member of an aggregate is unknown, so known n is 0
findings.guard_snippet: if k == member_count: render 'unknown (k unknown)', not '0+? (k unknown)'
findings.potential_consequence: All-unknown aggregate leads with a 0

findings.trigger_condition: Duplicate rows in one cycle carry different field values
findings.guard_snippet: within a cycle keep the row with newer observedAt; on tie or absent time flag 'conflicting duplicate'
findings.potential_consequence: Older duplicate may be shown; the contradiction is hidden

findings.trigger_condition: Duplicates ignored; unclear whether collected n counts before or after dedup
findings.guard_snippet: collected n = count of unique identities; duplicates reported only as 'k duplicate rows ignored'
findings.potential_consequence: False mismatch, or overstated collected count

findings.trigger_condition: Zero workers returned while scope is unknown or not bound
findings.guard_snippet: render 'worker-list returned 0 workers in scope=' + (scope.source or 'unknown')
findings.potential_consequence: Pinned literal asserts scope=bound when scope is unknown

findings.trigger_condition: Total Run count N is not given by any source
findings.guard_snippet: render 'read k of unknown Runs since start' when N is unknown
findings.potential_consequence: N invented, or shown as 0

findings.trigger_condition: R2+ start-up before any question-source read has succeeded
findings.guard_snippet: read the question source once before choosing the view, or state that B is never the start-up default
findings.potential_consequence: B can never become the default view

findings.trigger_condition: Orca present but slow or failing at the one-time discovery probe
findings.guard_snippet: render 'discovery probe failed (timeout)' distinct from 'not found'; retry probe on back-off
findings.potential_consequence: Session-long NOT AVAILABLE, misreported as binary not found

findings.trigger_condition: Width below the too-narrow message length, or resize across 80 mid-session
findings.guard_snippet: clip 'terminal too narrow (min 80)' to W cells; re-render on SIGWINCH
findings.potential_consequence: The diagnostic itself breaks cell_len <= W; stale layout after resize

findings.trigger_condition: NO_COLOR set to 0, false, or empty string
findings.guard_snippet: colour_off = os.environ.get('NO_COLOR', '') != ''
findings.potential_consequence: NO_COLOR=0 may keep colour; empty value may wrongly disable it

findings.trigger_condition: Non-UTF-8 locale and CJK or emoji in source strings
findings.guard_snippet: if --ascii or stdout encoding is not UTF-8: encode with errors='replace' after sanitizing
findings.potential_consequence: UnicodeEncodeError crash, possibly with terminal left in raw mode

findings.trigger_condition: Source string contains DEL (0x7F), which is outside C0, C1 and Cf
findings.guard_snippet: also strip '\x7f' in the sanitizer
findings.potential_consequence: DEL passes the sanitizer into screen and export

findings.trigger_condition: SIGTSTP, SIGCONT or SIGHUP while the key reader holds raw mode
findings.guard_snippet: restore termios on SIGTSTP and SIGHUP; re-enter raw mode on SIGCONT
findings.potential_consequence: Shell left in raw mode after Ctrl-Z or terminal hangup

findings.trigger_condition: --once cycle FAILED, PARTIAL or STALE; or the 'e' export write fails
findings.guard_snippet: --once exits nonzero unless source OK and complete; 'e' shows 'export failed: <reason>' on screen
findings.potential_consequence: Scripts archive a failed read as success; user believes export saved

findings.trigger_condition: Source value is literally 'UNKNOWN', or a numeric field is missing
findings.guard_snippet: encode missing as a distinct marker (e.g. {'unknown': true}) or document the string/number union
findings.potential_consequence: Real 'UNKNOWN' value indistinguishable from missing; numeric fields change type

findings.trigger_condition: Additive field added while integer schemaVersion stays 1
findings.guard_snippet: schemaVersion = 'MAJOR.MINOR'; bump MINOR on each additive change
findings.potential_consequence: Consumer cannot tell which optional fields to expect

findings.trigger_condition: Consumer reads the snapshot file while the observer is mid-write
findings.guard_snippet: write temp file in same directory, fsync, os.replace onto the snapshot path
findings.potential_consequence: Consumer reads torn JSON; FR-16 does not require an atomic write

findings.trigger_condition: 'm' pressed before the baseline exists, or session spans midnight
findings.guard_snippet: ignore 'm' until baseline exists; show date in 'changed since' after 24 h
findings.potential_consequence: Mark against no baseline; HH:MM ambiguous across days

findings.trigger_condition: Observer restarts and silently takes a new baseline
findings.guard_snippet: header shows 'new baseline at HH:MM (restart)' as the spec requires
findings.potential_consequence: Restart hides changes since the previous look

findings.trigger_condition: '/' filter hides the selected row or matches no rows
findings.guard_snippet: keep selection as 'selected <id> hidden by filter'; empty result reads 'no rows match filter; shown 0/y'
findings.potential_consequence: Filtered-empty view mistaken for an empty fleet

findings.trigger_condition: Rows whose owner is unknown in the per-owner counts
findings.guard_snippet: add an 'owner unknown' bucket so per-owner counts sum to the global count
findings.potential_consequence: Sum fails, or unknown-owner rows silently dropped

findings.trigger_condition: Evidence timestamp in the future or unparseable (U11)
findings.guard_snippet: negative age renders 'age unknown (clock ahead)'; unparseable renders 'unknown'
findings.potential_consequence: Negative or zero age reads as fresh evidence
